## Invariants

<!-- invariants:start -->

The single place a Stripe payment becomes an order. It is reached from the
webhook and from the checkout routers, and it must be idempotent: Stripe
redelivers events, and the same PaymentIntent must never produce two orders.

It sits above checkout, orders and gift because it drives all three. Nothing
may depend on it.

**Never automatically refund a captured payment.** When settlement cannot
complete, it records a reviewable order rather than reversing the money.

<!-- invariants:end -->
